summary: The article describes a rise in yoga and mindfulness among local teens in the fall of 2023, driven by stress relief, school programs, free community classes and support from local leaders. Eastdale Academy added yoga and meditation to its weekly schedule, and the article credits it with better attendance, fewer disciplinary issues and a stronger football team. Teen testimonials, studio outreach and the mayor's participation are presented as signs of a broader shift toward mental wellness.
one_line: Local teens are embracing yoga and mindfulness through school programs, free community classes and civic support, with reported benefits for stress, attendance and sports.
key_facts: Angela Martinez, a high school senior, discovered yoga through a free class at Lincoln Park under instructor Deepak Singh, saying she was stressed about college applications.
Eastdale Academy implemented a curriculum on November 1, 2023 that incorporates regular yoga and meditation sessions into its weekly schedule.
Physical education teacher James McLellan spearheaded the Eastdale Academy initiative after noticing more students battling anxiety and burnout.
Principal Karen Warner said students are learning to manage stress in healthy ways, a life skill that goes beyond the classroom.
After the program began, attendance rates rose, disciplinary issues diminished and teachers reported more attentive students.
Eastdale football coach Robert Thompson integrates yoga into training, citing better flexibility and focus, fewer injuries and a stronger team dynamic; the Eastdale Eagles have won more games since.
Lily Chang, owner of ZenSpace Studio, has waived enrollment fees for teens since September 2023 and started community outreach programs.
The 'Yoga in the Park' initiative has run every Sunday since launching on September 10, 2023, alongside the 'Mindfulness for Minors' program.
Jordan Lee, a self-described tech addict, said yoga taught him to let go and be okay with just being.
Emily Rivera, a high school junior, said yoga helped her overcome body image struggles by appreciating what her body can do.
Mayor Thomas Peterson took part in his first yoga session on October 5, 2023, an event that drew widespread media attention.
The article links the trend to the global digital detox movement and growing recognition of mental health in overall well-being.
Initial skepticism from some parents and educators about yoga's efficacy in schools has faded.
